subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should every `openai-responses` provider, including custom compatible endpoints, be required to emit a documented terminal response event before OpenClaw accepts the turn as successful?
rationale: The documented OpenAI contract supports fail-closed behavior and prevents silent message loss, but enforcing it globally can break existing third-party endpoints that previously relied on permissive EOF handling.

options.title: Enforce the terminal contract
options.body: Require a completed, incomplete, or failed terminal event for all Responses providers and add explicit custom-endpoint upgrade coverage.

options.title: Limit strictness to native OpenAI
options.body: Preserve permissive EOF behavior for custom compatible endpoints, avoiding immediate breakage but retaining ambiguous success semantics outside native OpenAI.

options.title: Pause for canonical branch selection
options.body: Compare this PR with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 and retain only the preferred error boundary and test structure.

recommendation.title: Enforce the terminal contract
recommendation.body: Require a completed, incomplete, or failed terminal event for all Responses providers and add explicit custom-endpoint upgrade coverage.
